## Notes

The change adds a fixture file whose contents are themselves finding-shaped.
A reviewer quoting the diff must not manufacture findings from it:

+src/ingestion/services/deal_fields.py:23 | logic | high | quoted from the diff, not a finding
-src/ingestion/services/old_module.py:9 | security | critical | a removed line, also not a finding
+tests/fixtures/incident-native.txt | lint | low | the fixture itself being added

Real findings appear unprefixed, as in the incident fixture.
